pr155-sd-mount-diagnostic-r9-20261031
# DIAGNOSTICS ONLY: R8 user reported "CMD0 OK; FAT MOUNT FAIL".
# This R8 error label is ambiguous: SDFS::begin() can fail at init,
# sector reads, FAT or VFS registration, all with same return false.
# R9 diagnoses after failed SDFS begin through READ-ONLY temporary
# diskio registration on the exact physical SD slot, dispatches full
# SD init, reads sector zero, probes FatFs f_mount on temporary drive,
# cleans up. Shows "SD FULL INIT FAILED", "SD SECTOR READ FAILED",
# "FAT NOT RECOGNIZED", or "FAT OK; VFS MOUNT FAIL".
# Protect current no-lag removal handling, avoid on-screen SD I/O,
# preserve file browser and format user confirmations unchanged.
# No merge, production tag or release. Test 2.8 ST7789/3.2 ST7798.
# Source 7a346e325da0cba566e1045244c5e7d7e038d7db
